column1: # Protocols that launch/party.sh can run. Each <script>.sh in this
# directory is a symbolic link to party.sh, and the link name selects a row.
# binary        executable that every party runs
# parties       -          two parties unless PLAYERS or -N says otherwise
#               fixed:n    n parties unless -N says otherwise
#               default:n  n parties unless PLAYERS or -N says otherwise
# list          the list-<list>-protocols.sh script that names it (or -)
#               threshold  pass -T $THRESHOLD if THRESHOLD is set
#               args=X     append X to the arguments
#               clean=G    delete the files matching G first
# Rows of one list appear in the order that list prints them.
